test_title: PYST 50: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the most suitable idiom for the given situation.**

Ravi has a strong desire to be in college hockey team this year and he is working hard to gain such skills to fulfill his goal of life. He has clearly made up his mind to achieve his target.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Set sights on'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most suitable idiom for the given situation is: **Set sights on.**
 
• **Explanation**:
 
 
• **"Set sights on"** means to choose or aim for a particular goal or target.
 
• In the context provided, Ravi has a clear and strong desire (setting his sights) to be part of the college hockey team, and he is actively working towards achieving that goal.
 
 
 
• **About the other options:**
 
 
• **To rise to the occasion:**
 
 
• This idiom means **to perform well or effectively in a challenging situation.**
 
• While Ravi is determined and focused on his goal, this idiom does not directly capture the aspect of setting a specific target, which is emphasized in the passage. 
 
 
 
• **To make the cut:**
 
 
• This idiom means** to meet the necessary requirements or qualifications.**
 
• While Ravi is indeed working hard to meet the requirements to be part of the college hockey team, this phrase typically refers more to meeting a standard rather than setting sights on a goal.
 
 
 
• **To move the goal posts:**
 
 
• This idiom means **to change the rules or requirements in a way that makes it harder to achieve a goal.**
 
• In the context provided, there is no indication that Ravi is facing changing requirements or obstacles imposed by others; instead, he is focused on achieving his goal with determination.
